title: Navy Secretary Kimball and Admiral Radford's planes circled by an object
summary: Richard Dolan tells of Navy Secretary Kimball and Admiral Radford's planes circled by an object, about 1950 at flight from California to Hawaii, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: was Kimble's plane and Radford's plane were both accosted by an object that circled around their aircraft.

plain: Richard Dolan, a historian of UFO reports, relays an account linked to the writer Donald Keyhoe about a flight from California to Hawaii around 1950. He says the planes carrying Dan Kimball, then Secretary of the Navy, and Admiral Arthur Radford, a senior Navy commander, were both approached by an unknown object that circled around them. If true, some of the highest Navy leaders would have seen a UFO up close themselves.
